title: SEMA: Simple yet Effective Learning for Multi-Turn Jailbreak Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2602.06854v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-turn jailbreaks capture the real threat model for safety-aligned chatbots, where single-turn attacks are merely a special case. Yet existing approaches break under exploration complexity and intent drift. We propose SEMA, a simple yet effective framework that trains a multi-turn attacker without relying on any existing strategies or external data. SEMA comprises two stages. Prefilling self-tuning enables usable rollouts by fine-tuning on non-refusal, well-structured, multi-turn adversarial prompts that are self-generated with a minimal prefix, thereby stabilizing subsequent learning. Reinforcement learning with intent-drift-aware reward trains the attacker to elicit valid multi-turn adversarial prompts while maintaining the same harmful objective. tldr: SEMA提出了一种无需外部数据或现有策略的两阶段训练框架，通过预填充自调整和意图漂移感知奖励的强化学习，有效解决多轮越狱攻击中的探索复杂性和意图漂移问题。
en_tdlr: SEMA proposes a two-stage training framework without external data or existing strategies, using prefilling self-tuning and intent-drift-aware reward reinforcement learning to effectively address exploration complexity and intent drift in multi-turn jailbreak attacks.
